Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. This new feature lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on so you never have to rebuild a view from scratch. Set up a custom view once, name it, and it will be there whenever you need it, whether you are tracking overdue tasks, planning a sprint, or reviewing work by owner.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views around different projects, clients, or workflows without hitting a limit. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own. Shared views update automatically, keeping teammates aligned as priorities shift.

We built this feature based on feedback from teams who wanted faster ways to organize their work and cut down on repetitive setup. It is ready for you to try right now, on any list in your workspace.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
